test_title: PYST 32: SSC CHSL 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 11 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question:
Three of the following four are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which is the one that does NOT belong to that group? 

(1) 4 - 27

(2) 6 - 125

(3) 7 - 216

(4) 5 - 63
solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Logic:** (First number - 1)³ = Second number

 
• 4 - 27 → (4 - 1)³ = 3³ = 27
 
• 6 - 125 → (6 - 1)3 = 53 = 125
 
• 7 - 216 → (7 - 1)3 = 63 = 216
 
• **5 - 63 → (5 - 1)3 = 43 = 64 ≠ 63**

Hence, '**4**' is the correct answer.
